summary: Frontend-only QA on iteration_2 (addendum 5/6) of the CEECO HDPE PIPES static SPA at https://ceeco-hdpe.preview.emergentagent.com. Validated all 6 addendum items (#1 office address, #2 factory address with Manufacturing Unit label, #3 footer + contact map links + iframes + Open in Google Maps CTAs, #4 5 real client logos, #5 PE chips removed from hero PN strip + hero img switched to FACTORY.jpeg, #6 Why HDPE pipe cross-section redesign with concentric rings + cavity text + '· PIPE CROSS-SECTION ·' annotation) and the 8 regression smoke items (6-link navbar with no Infrastructure/Gallery, mobile drawer opens, WhatsApp button, Contact + Careers forms submit with sonner toast, footer copyright '© 2026 S D Ruparel Group', tel:+918043729397, hours '10:00 AM - 7:00 PM'). 54/54 effective checks passed. NO em-dash characters found anywhere in visible body text on Home or Contact. Old placeholders '[Your Office Address]' and '[Your Factory Address]' fully removed. 'Factory Address' label gone — replaced with 'Manufacturing Unit' everywhere.

issues: Radix UI a11y console warning: 'DialogContent requires a DialogTitle for screen reader users.' Still unresolved from previous iteration. Non-blocking, low priority.

action_items: (Optional, low-priority) Add a VisuallyHidden DialogTitle inside the mobile menu Sheet in /app/frontend/src/components/layout/Header.jsx to silence the Radix a11y console warning (carry-over from iteration_1, still present).
critical_code_review_comments: site.js cleanly centralises the new address objects with mapUrl + embedQuery for both office and factory — single source of truth, both Footer and Contact consume it correctly.
Contact.jsx uses encodeURIComponent on the embedQuery for both iframe srcs which is the safe pattern.
ClientsMarquee.jsx uses lazy-loaded with proper alt text — good for perf + a11y.

WhyHDPE PipeCrossSection is implemented purely with nested rounded-full divs + CSS gradients (no external image), keeping bundle small. The annotation correctly uses U+00B7 middle dots ('·'), not em dashes.
